12001.desc: A W-Engine that prioritizes damage output over noise reduction. It can indiscriminately deal considerable damage to all units nearby.
12001.effect_desc: <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>12%</color>.

12002.desc: A W-Engine with excellent sonic and thermal energy usage, capable of hitting its target with a double whammy.
12002.effect_desc: Launching a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> increases the equipper's DMG by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 6s.

12003.desc: A high-capacity portable W-Engine that can collect dissipated energy from its surroundings, thus enhancing the combat effectiveness of its operator.
12003.effect_desc: Launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> generates <color=#2BAD00>3</color> Energy for the equipper. This effect can trigger once every 12s.

12004.desc: A special W-Engine featuring a built-in sonic generator that boosts its damage output.
12004.effect_desc: Launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> increases all squad members' Impact by <color=#2BAD00>8%</color> for 10s. This effect can trigger once every 20s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

12005.desc: A standardized W-Engine with balanced performance that enhances its owner's and their teammates' combat effectiveness in all aspects.
12005.effect_desc: Launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> increases all squad members' Anomaly Mastery and Anomaly Proficiency by <color=#2BAD00>10</color> for 10s. This effect can trigger once every 20s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

12006.desc: A special W-Engine that features motion capture algorithms, which enhance the overall combat competency of your squad.
12006.effect_desc: Launching a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> increases all squad members' ATK by <color=#2BAD00>8%</color> for 10s. This effect can trigger once every 20s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

12007.desc: An energy-storage type W-Engine with a unique operation circuit. It will absorb scattered energy up to a certain amount before unleashing it all at once.

12008.desc: A tactical W-Engine that locates enemies using high-frequency sound waves. Its aiming aid can make its operator's precision attack more deadly.
12008.effect_desc: The equipper's attacks inflict <color=#2BAD00>8%</color> more Daze on their main target.

12009.desc: A frequency-converting W-Engine that can quickly generate excessive power and effectively increase its user's battle prowess.
12009.effect_desc: Upon becoming the active character in combat, the equipper's Impact increases by <color=#2BAD00>9%</color> for 10s. This effect can trigger once every 20s.

12010.desc: A special W-Engine that can analyze the target's weak spots through real-time calculations.
12010.effect_desc: Accumulating Anomaly Buildup increases the equipper's Anomaly Mastery by <color=#2BAD00>25</color> for 10s. This effect can trigger once every 20s.

12011.desc: A damage-type W-Engine that features an enhanced movement detection module that can quickly alter its output intensity to optimize battle efficiency.
12011.effect_desc: Accumulating Anomaly Buildup increases the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency by <color=#2BAD00>25</color> for 10s. This effect can trigger once every 20s.

12012.desc: A high-capacity W-Engine that features a built-in generator, which allows it to keep a stable storage of electrical power.
12012.effect_desc: Whenever a squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, the equipper generates <color=#2BAD00>3.5</color> Energy. This effect can trigger once every 12s.

12013.desc: A W-Engine with a component structure adjusted according to specific parameters. It can enhance the defensive capabilities of those who have a certain style of combat.
12013.effect_desc: When attacked, the equipper's DEF increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 8s.

12014.desc: A functional W-Engine that specializes in energy conversion. It can analyze combat environments and generate special sounds to disrupt the enemy's offense.
12014.effect_desc: When attacked, reduces the attacker's DMG by <color=#2BAD00>6%</color> for 12s.

12015.desc: A W-Engine with a built-in heating component. When operating at high speeds, it resembles a blazing blue flame.
12015.effect_desc: Upon becoming the active character in combat, the equipper's ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>7.2%</color> for 10s. This effect can trigger once every 20s.

12016.desc: A cost-effective choice for newcomers exploring Hollows.
12016.effect_desc: When using an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Basic Attack DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>18%</color> for 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

13001.desc: A custom-made W-Engine designed for urban music lovers. It sacrifices heat dissipation components for improved sound quality.
13001.effect_desc: Whenever a squad member launches a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, the equipper gains 1 Charge stack, stacking up to 3 times. Upon activating their own <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, the equipper consumes all Charge stacks, and each stack increases the skill's DMG by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.

13002.desc: A special W-Engine equipped with a high-speed camera module. The best choice for in-Hollow photography enthusiasts.
13002.effect_desc: Any squad members' <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> respectively generates <color=#2BAD00>20</color>/<color=#2BAD00>25</color>/<color=#2BAD00>30</color>/<color=#2BAD00>35</color> more Decibels and generates <color=#2BAD00>0.7</color> Energy for the equipper. This effect can trigger once every 12s. The cooldown for each type of attack is independent of others. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

13003.desc: A consumer-class W-Engine launched by an exotic pet fan club to promote pet culture. Due to its cute appearance, it was once a very popular model.
13003.effect_desc: For every 10 Energy consumed, the equipper gains a buff that increases ATK by <color=#2BAD00>2.5%</color> for 10s, stacking up to 10 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

13004.desc: A damage-type W-Engine made of special Etheric matter. When its user is attacked, it builds up energy.
13004.ja: スターライトエンジン
13004.effect_desc: Launching a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> increases the equipper's ATK by <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> for 12s.

13005.desc: A high-power W-Engine that boasts a cutting-edge energy conversion system. It collects excess heat and supplies it to the steamer.
13005.effect_desc: For every 10 Energy accumulated, the equipper's Impact is increased by <color=#2BAD00>2%</color>, stacking up to 8 times. After Energy is consumed, this bonus remains for 8 more seconds. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

13006.desc: A special W-Engine whose outer shell is made of composite Etheric matter that effectively absorbs impact, and turns it against the enemy.
13006.effect_desc: When the target's HP is no lower than 50%, the equipper inflicts <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> more Daze to the target. When the target's HP is no lower than 75%, this bonus is further increased by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.

13007.desc: An epic W-Engine favored by Starlight Knight fans. Its high popularity and scarcity marketing strategy have caused an influx of knock-offs.
13007.effect_desc: Increases Max HP by <color=#2BAD00>8%</color>. When attacked, the equipper's Impact is increased by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for 12s.

13008.desc: A W-Engine produced by recycling abandoned Bangboo shells. Its electrode cores made of recycled metals can release high-voltage charges.
13008.effect_desc: Whenever a squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, the equipper gains a buff that increases Anomaly Proficiency by <color=#2BAD00>30</color>, stacking up to 4 times. This effect expires when the target recovers from Stun or is defeated. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

13009.desc: This damage-type W-Engine boasts a built-in current transformer, and automatically attracts electrically sensitive objects around the operator and deals additional damage to them.
13009.effect_desc: When there are enemies inflicted with Attribute Anomaly on the field, the equipper's ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> and they deal an additional <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> more DMG to the target.

13010.desc: A special W-Engine decorated with a fluffy bunny. However, it is just an imitation of the real animal.
13010.ja: ラビットチャージャー
13010.effect_desc: Increases Max HP by <color=#2BAD00>8%</color>. Increases the equipper's ATK by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> when they are shielded.

13011.desc: A special W-Engine equipped with a temperature regulator where residual heat generated by the W-Engine's high frequency is funneled into the hot springs on its surface.
13011.effect_desc: Reduces DMG taken by <color=#2BAD00>7.5%</color>. When attacked, the equipper's Energy Generation Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for 12s. When the equipper switches off-field, this buff will be transferred to the new on-field character with its duration refreshed. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

13012.desc: The W-Engine, with its bright colors and great performance, saw poor sales at first because it resembled a toy. But with its reasonable price, it slowly gained a positive reputation.
13012.effect_desc: Upon launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the equipper's CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>16%</color> for 12s. Additionally, if the target's current HP is below 50% of their Max HP, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.

13013.desc: A W-Engine with a grandiose and luxurious appearance equipped with a premium Ether-powered anti-theft device. It's actually used to provide the equipper with energy.
13013.effect_desc: ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>6</color>%, and DMG dealt by <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.

13014.desc: Designed for those Hollow-dwelling bards who refuse to listen to the same albums repeatedly, this W-Engine comes equipped with a radio module that can transform Etheric frequencies into melodies.
13014.effect_desc: When launching a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, the equipper gains 1 stack of a buff effect. Each stack increases the equipper's Sheer Force by <color=#2BAD00>80</color>, stacking up to 3 times, and lasting 12s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

13015.desc: Gather 'round, mortals! Turn up the music!
13015.effect_desc: When an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> hits an enemy, the equipper's ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>6%</color> for 8s. While the target is under an Attribute Anomaly, this effect is increased by an additional <color=#2BAD00>6%</color>.

13016.desc: Clearly a W-Engine is for sound, and not images. What kind of lunatic genius would insist on stuffing a 16mm film camera into a W-Engine?
13016.effect_desc: When a squad member's HP is greater than or equal to 50%, they take <color=#2BAD00>7.5%</color> less DMG, and <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> less Miasma Contamination. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

13017.desc: Meow your way to good luck!
13017.effect_desc: DEF increases by <color=#2BAD00>8%</color>. When using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, DEF increases by an additional <color=#2BAD00>8%</color> for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

13018.desc: Pick it up and play another thunk-thud concerto!
13018.effect_desc: When the equipper triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color> effect, they gain <color=#2BAD00>2</color> Energy. This effect can trigger once every 10s. When attacking enemies afflicted with an Attribute Anomaly, the equipper deals <color=#2BAD00>11.5%</color> increased DMG.

13019.desc: Countless threads of Sword Will echo through this tiny stretch of sky.
13019.effect_desc: When the equipper activates an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, they gain 1 stack of a buff. Each stack increases the equipper's DMG by <color=#2BAD00>4%</color>, up to 3 stacks, and lasting 20s. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. At 3 stacks, the equipper's CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>6.5%</color>.

13020.desc: Whoa, that's hot! Seriously hot! But it's so good!
13020.effect_desc: When activating an <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, the equipper's Daze inflicted on the target increases by <color=#2BAD00>7.2%</color>, and DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>7.2%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

13021.desc: A special W-Engine developed by the Flint family.
13021.effect_desc: When the equipper's CRIT Rate exceeds <color=#2BAD00>100%</color>, each 1% of CRIT Rate above 100% increases DMG dealt by <color=#2BAD00>0.48%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>24%</color>.

13101.desc: A customized W-Engine that focuses on energy storage, modified to improve its energy capacity. This model is often used by Anby.
13101.effect_desc: Increases <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>. When the equipper hits an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Attack</color>, their Energy Generation Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>18%</color> for 8s.

13103.desc: A cost-effective W-Engine that can store energy, with improvements made to its internal space. This model is often used by Nicole.
13103.effect_desc: Dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> using an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> increases all units' DMG against the target by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> and increases the equipper's Energy Regen by <color=#2BAD00>0.5</color>/s for 2s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

13106.desc: An enhanced W-Engine with a high rotation speed. A chainsaw has been integrated into its shaft. This model is often used by Corin.
13106.effect_desc: While off-field, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by <color=#2BAD00>0.45</color>/s. When an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> hits an enemy, the equipper's <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>3%</color>, stacking up to 15 times and lasting 1s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

13108.desc: A customized supercomputing W-Engine, specialized in aim support and ballistic calculations. Modified by Billy, it now looks like some sort of knock-off Starlight Knight figurine.
13108.ja: なんちゃってスターライトエンジン
13108.effect_desc: Increases the equipper's <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> against the target by <color=#2BAD00>36%</color> for 8s upon hitting an enemy at least 6 meters away with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>.

13111.desc: Originally a rev-enhanced W-Engine, it has been modified by Anton with the most expensive rotary drill parts that allow it to exceed its output limits.
13111.ja: ドリルリグ-レッドシャフト
13111.effect_desc: When launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> from <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attacks</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color> for 10s. This effect can trigger once every 15s.

13112.desc: A powerful protection-type W-Engine, characterized by thick oil cylinders that ceaselessly roar inside it. It can provide sufficient power for heavy machinery.
13112.effect_desc: Reduces DMG taken by <color=#2BAD00>7.5%</color>. After being attacked, the next attack to hit an enemy will trigger a critical hit and deal <color=#2BAD00>600%</color> of the equipper's DEF as additional DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 7.5s.

13113.desc: An intricate W-Engine developed by Section 6 and later modified with extra features. It can control Ether particles to form an energy field. This model is favored by Soukaku.
13113.effect_desc: Increases <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>. When launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, all squad members' ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>2%</color> for 12s, stacking up to 4 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

13115.desc: A support W-Engine propelled by jets that is both mobile and impactful, it can traverse the entire battlefield providing combat buffs.
13115.ja: 喧嘩腰のボンバルダム
13115.effect_desc: When any friendly unit in the squad attacks and hits an enemy, all friendly units' ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>2.5%</color> for 8s, stacking up to 4 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately, and each friendly unit can provide 1 stack of the buff. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

13127.desc: A defensive W-Engine independently researched and created by Public Security which simplifies the offensive components to enhance the energy conversion ability in its shield.
13127.ja: 秩序の守り手・特化型
13127.effect_desc: While Shielded, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by <color=#2BAD00>0.4</color>/s. The Anomaly Buildup of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Ups</color> increase by <color=#2BAD00>36%</color>.

13128.desc: An energy W-Engine modded from spare parts of a truck's engine. It converts the original cylinder into an energy storage unit, which is highly advantageous.
13128.ja: グロウル・マイ・カー
13128.effect_desc:
When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> hits an enemy, one of three possible effects is randomly triggered for 5 seconds. This effect can trigger once every 0.3s. The same types of effects cannot stack. Repeated triggers reset the duration, allowing several effects to be active at once:
Increases the equipper's ATK by <color=#2BAD00>8%</color>, increases the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency by <color=#2BAD00>40</color>, or increases the equipper's Anomaly Buildup Rate by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>.

13135.desc: An energy W-Engine modded from spare parts of a truck's engine. It converts the original cylinder into an energy storage unit, which is highly advantageous.
13135.effect_desc: Upon launching an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, the equipper's <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>, and Daze increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>, lasting 10s.

13142.desc: Pressing acupoints is like cooking. Striking the fatal acupoint is like setting the stove on fire, bringing disaster.
13142.effect_desc: The equipper's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>. Whenever any squad member takes DMG or recovers HP, the equipper gains <color=#2BAD00>2</color> Energy. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

13144.desc: A flame both fierce and faithful, burning without end.
13144.effect_desc: The equipper's <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>. When the equipper's HP decreases, their CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 5s.

14001.desc: A high-performance supercomputing W-Engine, capable of collecting real-time battlefield data and equipped with mini cannons.
14001.effect_desc: Increases ATK by <color=#2BAD00>7.5%</color>. Landing a critical hit on an enemy will inflict an additional 200% of ATK as DMG. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>8</color>s.

14002.desc: A new supercomputing W-Engine, featuring cutting-edge integrated chips that dynamically monitor the battlefield and provide tactical analysis for the user.
14002.effect_desc: Whenever the equipper's attack triggers an Attribute Counter effect, all units' CRIT Rate against the struck enemy increases by <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> for 12s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

14003.desc: A special W-Engine modeled after a revolver. It can load bullet-shaped condensed Ether batteries, which release a great amount of power when fired.
14003.effect_desc: The equipper gains 1 Charge stack every 3s, stacking up to 6 times. When launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, consumes all Charge stacks and each stack consumed increases the skill's Daze inflicted by <color=#2BAD00>4%</color>.

14102.desc: A supercomputing W-Engine equipped with a motion monitoring feature. Thanks to Nekomata's modifications, it perfectly matches the fast reflexes and combat maneuvers of feline Thirens.
14102.effect_desc: Increases <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>. The equipper's DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> when hitting the enemy from behind.

14104.desc: A W-Engine made for Soldier 11 by Obsidian Division. Its intense heat can be used to clear the entire battlefield.
14104.effect_desc: Upon hitting an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, the equipper's ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>3.5%</color> for 8s, stacking up to 8 times. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

14105.desc: In chasing illusions, she was entranced by the light that pierced through the mist.
14105.ja: セイレーンクレードル
14105.effect_desc: When the equipper's HP decreases, their <color=#98EFF0>Ice Sheer DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>6%</color>, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 25s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s. When the equipper's HP falls to 50% of Max HP or below, CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.

14107.desc: A versatile W-Engine based on a motorcycle tire that Big Daddy made for Caesar.
14107.effect_desc: The Shield value provided by the equipper increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>. When any squad member triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Interrupt</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, all squad members' DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>18%</color> and Daze dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> for 20s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

14109.desc: Hail falls before the shrine, waking her. The blizzard is coming.
14109.effect_desc: CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>. When using an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or when any squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, the equipper's <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 15s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

14110.desc: A functional W-Engine with ultra-high power capacity. Modified by Koleda, its energy level has almost exceeded the safety limit.
14110.effect_desc:
While off-field, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by <color=#2BAD00>0.6</color>/s.
When using an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the equipper's Impact is increased by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for 10s, stacking up to 2 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

14114.desc: A special W-Engine with a powerful temperature control system. Modified by Lycaon, it has the capability to quickly create extremely cold environments.
14114.effect_desc: When an attack hits an enemy, DMG and Daze from <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> increase by <color=#2BAD00>6%</color> for 8s, stacking up to 5 times. This effect can trigger at most once during each skill. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

14116.desc: A violent W-Engine that can ignite flames with a siphon. It deals simple and crude burn damage, encouraging relentless, bone-crushing follow-up attacks.
14116.effect_desc: Upon launching a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Assist</color>, the equipper's Impact increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> for 8s. When the equipper launches and hits an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, apply <color=#FFFFFF>Wilt</color> to the target for 30s, stacking up to 20 times, repeated triggers reset the duration. When any squad member hits an enemy, for every stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Wilt</color> applied to the target, the CRIT DMG of the <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> dealt by that attack increases by <color=#2BAD00>1.5%</color>. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

14117.desc: Modified by Burnice, this W-Engine uses a special fuel as its power source to boost combustion performance to the max.
14117.ja: バーニング・シェイカー
14117.effect_desc: While off-field, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by <color=#2BAD00>0.6</color>/s. When hitting an enemy with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Attack</color>, the equipper's DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>3.5%</color>, stacking up to 10 times and lasting for 6s. This effect can trigger once every 0.3s. While off-field, the stack effect is doubled. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Upon obtaining the DMG increase effect, if the number of current stacks is greater than or equal to 5, then the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>50</color>. This Anomaly Proficiency increase does not stack and lasts for 6s.

14118.desc: The latest W-Engine that possesses a hypercalculation core. It can compile operational codes for machines at top speed. This model is favored by Grace.
14118.effect_desc:
Increases ATK by <color=#2BAD00>12%</color>.
When using a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency is increased by <color=#2BAD00>25</color> for 8s, stacking up to 3 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

14119.desc: A high-power W-Engine that possesses efficient freezing capabilities and high damage output. This model is often used by Ellen.
14119.ja: ディープシー・ビジター
14119.effect_desc: Increases <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>. Upon hitting an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, the equipper's CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for 8s. When dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> with a <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, the equipper's CRIT Rate increases by an additional <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for 15s. The duration of each effect is calculated separately.

14120.desc: Bitterness and pain beget hope, and he devours them all.
14120.effect_desc: CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>. When any squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly or Stuns an enemy, the equipper's CRIT Rate increases by an additional <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for 15s.

14121.desc: A special W-Engine with multiple layers embedded inside. It can quickly recharge 	special-model Bangboo and custom-made combat equipment. This model is favored by Rina.
14121.effect_desc: While off-field, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by <color=#2BAD00>0.6</color>/s. Attacks from the equipper increase all units' DMG against a struck target by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for 3 seconds. During this period, this effect is further increased by <color=#2BAD00>1.7%</color> every 0.5s, up to a maximum additional increase of <color=#2BAD00>10.2%</color>. Repeated triggers only refresh the duration without refreshing the DMG increase effect. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

14122.desc: A new model of supercomputing W-Engine custom-made by HSO Section 6, equipped with the most elite calculation and analysis functions.
14122.effect_desc:
The equipper's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>. When <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attacks</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> hit enemies suffering an Attribute Anomaly, the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>75</color> for 15s.
When the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency is greater than or equal to 375, <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG inflicted by the equipper increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>.

14124.desc: The latest tactical W-Engine used by Public Security's elite Hollow squads, possessing a powerful Ether energy source. It's Zhu Yuan's favored model.
14124.effect_desc: Increases CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>. Launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> grants the equipper 8 Charge stacks, up to a maximum of 8 stacks. Whenever the equipper's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> deals <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>, consumes a Charge stack and increases the skill's DMG by <color=#2BAD00>35%</color>.

14125.desc: A custom stun W-Engine made for an Automaton referencing the combat style and abilities of one. Energy is stored within, then lashes outwards upon conversion.
14125.effect_desc: When a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> hits an enemy, gain 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Tea-riffic</color>. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Tea-riffic</color> increases the user's Impact by <color=#2BAD00>0.7%</color>, stacking up to 30 times, and lasting for 8s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. Upon acquiring <color=#FFFFFF>Tea-riffic</color>, if the equipper possesses stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Tea-riffic</color> greater than or equal to 15, all squad members' DMG is increased by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 10s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

14126.desc: A deadly W-Engine from unknown sources, modified personally by Jane Doe with the intent to deal severe physical damage and Anomaly.
14126.effect_desc: Upon activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, gain 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Predatory Instinct</color>. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Predatory Instinct</color> increases the equipper's <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> for 10s, stacking up to 3 times. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When entering combat or triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, gain 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Predatory Instinct</color>. While <color=#FFFFFF>Predatory Instinct</color> is at maximum stacks, the equipper's Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>.

14129.desc: Shadowed by darkness at every step, he laid bare his heart to kindle a single, flickering flame.
14129.effect_desc: Increases CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>45%</color>. When using an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> to deal <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>, the equipper gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Absolute Zero Death Sentence</color> effect for 3s. While <color=#FFFFFF>Absolute Zero Death Sentence</color> is active, the character ignores <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> of the enemy's DEF when landing a hit.

14130.desc: She lingers by the banks of the Styx, waiting for the tide to extinguish the fury burning in her chamber.
14130.effect_desc: Increases CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>. When the equipper triggers an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> that deals <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>, their attacks ignore <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> of the target's DEF for 8s. Can stack once every 3s, up to 2 stacks. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

14131.desc: Underneath the radiant splendor, her genuine self has never been hidden.
14131.effect_desc: When any squad member enters the field through a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color>, the equipper gains <color=#2BAD00>5</color> Energy. This effect can trigger once every 5s. When the equipper consumes 25 or more Energy, the DMG dealt by all squad members increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>, stacking up to 2 times, and lasting 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

14132.desc: The sound of the strings, sharp as blades, cut through the night, protecting the one.
14132.effect_desc: CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>. When the equipper enters combat, or activates a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, they gain 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Heartstring</color>. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Heartstring</color> allows the equipper's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> to ignore <color=#2BAD00>12.5%</color> of the target's <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color>, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

14133.desc: A bird landed on the windowsill, scattering starlight from its tail feathers.
14133.ja: 鳥は夢へと羽ばたいて
14133.effect_desc: Increases Anomaly Buildup Rate by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>. When the equipper deals <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>, their Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>20</color> for 5s, stacking up to 6 times. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s, and repeated triggers reset the duration.

14134.desc: Not too sweet, and not too cold.
14134.effect_desc: The equipper's Energy Regen increases by <color=#2BAD00>0.46</color>/s. All squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> ATK and <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> Max HP. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad. When the equipper activates or extends an <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, all squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> CRIT DMG for 60s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

14136.desc: Broken eyes hold both resilience and vulnerability.
14136.effect_desc: When the equipper's <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> hits an enemy, causing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>, the target's DEF is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> for 5s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack. When this effect is triggered, if the equipper is not the active character, they gain 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Spirit Lock</color>, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. This can trigger only once per use of a skill. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Spirit Lock</color> increases the equipper's Impact by <color=#2BAD00>4%</color>, lasting 12s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. At full stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Spirit Lock</color>, the equipper's Impact increases by an additional <color=#2BAD00>8%</color>.

14137.desc: The world is vast and full of change, and fate is unpredictable. But regardless of hardship or lack thereof, one must stay true to one's heart.
14137.effect_desc: CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>. When the equipper launches an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the character gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Companion</color> effect, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 15s. On entering combat, immediately gain 2 stacks. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Each stack of the <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Companion</color> effect increases the equipper's <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>8%</color>, and increases Ultimate and EX Special Attack <color=#FE437E>Ether Sheer DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.

14138.desc: The sheen of silver is not innocence. Can the blades of the past cut through fate's connections?
14138.effect_desc: CRIT DMG is increased by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>. When the equipper lands a hit with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, they gain 1 stack of a buff. Each stack increases the equipper's CRIT DMG by an additional <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>, stacking up to 3 times. The effect lasts for 30s, with each stack's duration calculated separately, and can only be triggered once per use of a skill. With all 3 stacks, the equipper's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.

14139.desc: The warm fire blazes through the long night, casting light on the tiger's roar in my heart.
14139.effect_desc:
The Daze dealt by the equipper's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>28%</color>.
When using a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> to deal <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>, the DMG dealt by all squad members increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 30s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. Triggers once per use of a skill. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

14140.desc: Starlight became her blade, and she held courage and love firmly in her hands.
14140.effect_desc: The equipper's <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly Mastery</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>60</color>. When inflicting <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color>, the equipper's <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 20s, stacking up to 2 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When the equipper enters combat, immediately gain 2 stacks.

14141.desc: A masterfully crafted design, infused with the creator's pursuit of beauty.
14141.effect_desc: When the equipper's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>, their <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly Mastery</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>30</color> for 40s. When the equipper's <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> hits an enemy, all squad members' <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly Proficiency</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>60</color> for 40s. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

14143.desc: The world may change, but my heart remains constant, like clouds standing eternal.
14143.effect_desc: The equipper's DMG ignores <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> of the target's <color=#F0D12B>Physical RES</color>. When the equipper activates an <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, the equipper's DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> and CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

14145.desc: After countless years, it remains a silent puzzle.
14145.ja: 炉で歌い上げられる夢
14145.effect_desc: The equipper's Energy Regen increases by <color=#2BAD00>0.4</color>/s. When the equipper activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color> or extends its duration, all squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> increased DMG and <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> increased Max HP for 45s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

14146.desc: Her journey continues along the long, endless circle.
14146.effect_desc: Increases CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>. When the equipper deals DMG with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, they gain 1 stack of a buff. Each stack increases the equipper's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>12.5%</color>, up to 2 stacks. Each stack lasts 40s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. Can trigger once per use of a skill. At 2 stacks, the wearer's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> DMG ignore <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> of enemy DEF.

14147.desc: The purging flames burned a hundred times, yet never cleansed me.
14147.effect_desc: CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>. When the equipper launches an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, their <color=#FF5521>Fire Sheer DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>9%</color>, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 20s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

14148.desc: That call you never picked up... she's the one who answered it.
14148.effect_desc: While off-field, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by <color=#2BAD00>1.5</color>/s. When the equipper deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the Daze dealt by the equipper's attacks increases by <color=#2BAD00>9%</color> for 10s, stacking up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, all squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> additional CRIT DMG for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Only one instance of this CRIT DMG boost effect can exist in the same squad.

14149.desc: Thoughts follow the veins of fantasy, weaving themselves into song.
14149.effect_desc: While not the active character, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by <color=#2BAD00>0.6</color>/s. When the equipper uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> and deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>, all squad members gain a buff that increases DMG dealt by <color=#2BAD00>12.5%</color> for 40s, stacking up to 2 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. At 2 stacks, characters gain an additional <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> ATK. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

14150.desc: There is a soul, even within a shell of steel.
14150.effect_desc: Increases the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency by <color=#2BAD00>90</color>. When the equipper is an <color=#FE437E>Ether</color> character, and comes on-field or uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, they gain a buff: DMG dealt to enemies afflicted with Attribute Anomalies increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>, and all Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG they trigger increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>, lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration, and the effect is removed when switching off-field.

14151.desc: A risky and unpredictable delusion that's impossible to refuse.
14151.effect_desc: The equipper's Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>90</color>. When the equipper's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> deals <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>, all squad members' DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 40s, stacking up to 2 times. This effect can trigger once per use of a skill and repeated triggers reset the duration. With 2 stacks, the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency increases by an additional <color=#2BAD00>60</color>. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

14152.desc: Digital venom flows beneath those alloy scales.
14152.effect_desc: CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>. When the equipper consumes at least 20 Energy in a single instance, every 20 Energy consumed grants 3s of a buff: when dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>, ignore <color=#2BAD00>28%</color> of the target's DEF. Repeated triggers extend the duration, up to a maximum of 30s. When entering combat, gain 10s of this buff. While the equipper is not the active character, the duration no longer decreases.

14153.desc: The proof of being a knight is within your grasp.
14153.ja: スターライトバイザー
14153.effect_desc: Increases CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>. When the equipper launches a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, their <color=#F0D12B>Physical Sheer DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

14154.desc: Carry out judgment until the end comes.
14154.ja: フロスト・クレセント
14154.effect_desc: When an <color=#98EFF0>Ice attribute</color> equipper uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, their <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> is increased by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 40s, stacking up to 2 times, once per use of a skill. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. At 2 stacks, the equipper's <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG dealt is increased by an additional <color=#2BAD00>35%</color>.

14155.desc: The blazing sun falls, leaving the trapped beast with nowhere left to run.
14155.effect_desc: CRIT Rate increases by 20%. When the equipper is Pyrois, using an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> grants the Eclipse effect. When the Eclipse effect is active, DMG dealt by the equipper ignores <color=#2BAD00>16%</color> of <color=#FE437E>Ether RES</color>, lasting 45s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When the equipper enters combat, they gain the Eclipse effect.

14156.desc: Sit quietly, and listen to the wind's song.
14156.effect_desc: The equipper's Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>70</color>. When the equipper's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> deals <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>, the DMG dealt by their <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color> and <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>7%</color> for 40s, stacking up to 2 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. This effect can trigger once per skill use. At 2 stacks, all squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>60</color> Anomaly Proficiency. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

14157.desc: Nhe-nha ehn ne! (Through fire and flames for Lady Norma!)
14157.effect_desc: The equipper's Impact increases by <color=#2BAD00>30</color>, and their DMG ignores <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> of the target's <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color>. When the equipper is not the active character, Energy Regen increases by <color=#2BAD00>0.4</color>/s. When the equipper deals <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, all Agents' DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>12.5%</color> for 30s, stacking up to 2 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. This effect can trigger once per skill. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

14158.desc: Drifting through the cracks of time in search of the light.
14158.effect_desc: Increases Anomaly Proficiency by <color=#2BAD00>96</color>. When the equipper triggers a <color=#FFA9DD>Refringe</color> reaction, they gain <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> increased Anomaly DMG, and all squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> increased DMG dealt. Both effects last 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

14159.desc: Across the vast skies and seas of clouds, the extolment for the knights echoes in quiet reverence.
14159.effect_desc:
When the equipper's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>'s heavy attack hits an enemy, they gain 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Battle Edge</color>, increasing CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>32%</color> for 25s. <color=#FFFFFF>Battle Edge</color> can stack up to 2 times, and each skill type can provide up to 1 stack. Repeated triggers refresh the duration of all <color=#FFFFFF>Battle Edge</color>.
At 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Battle Edge</color>, the equipper gains <color=#FFFFFF>Bonechill</color>: Their DMG ignores <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> of the target's <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color>.

14161.desc: Beneath the crimson moon, the bloodline endures.
14161.effect_desc: The equipper's CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>, and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>. When the equipper uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Maim</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Sharp DMG</color> dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

14162.desc: The crimson moon rises, and the long night knows no sleep.
14162.effect_desc: The equipper's CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>24%</color>. DMG dealt ignores <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> of the target's <color=#A6C5FD>Wind RES</color>. When the equipper uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> to deal <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>, Daze dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>16%</color>, and DMG dealt by all other squad members increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>, for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Only one instance of the DMG increase effect can exist in the same squad.
